**Current positioning (what the journal accepts now):** Journal of the Augustinian Institute (Villanova University), published by Philosophy Documentation Center, ISSN 0094-5323 (print) / 2153-7917 (online), semi-annual. Primary focus is Augustine of Hippo studied from theological, philosophical, and historical perspectives; also accepts studies of figures, groups, or issues from Augustine's era when they illuminate his life or thought. Also publishes the annual Saint Augustine Lecture (Villanova, each fall) and article-length book reviews.

**Methods noted as welcome (qualitative — not a scored 0-5 table, see Methodological Preferences below):** historical-theological analysis, philosophical/textual analysis of Augustine's writings, history (patristic/late antique), classics, reception history, article-length critical book reviews
